args.title: Tamarack Components: Freight pricing summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Tamarack Components' latest newsletter, "Freight pricing this quarter," highlights this week's freight pricing analysis and points readers to the full article on their blog, noting a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Article (blog.tamarack.example/2026/freight): Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/freight/companion, subscriber access): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
